basic_details.scholarship_name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship Program
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Toronto (St. George, Mississauga, and Scarborough campuses)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all direct-entry undergraduate programs across Arts & Science, Applied Science & Engineering, Commerce (Rotman), Architecture, Music, and Kinesiology.
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; typically 1 to 2 exceptional Pakistani high school students selected annually

nationality_requirements: International students (non-Canadian citizens requiring a Canadian study permit)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Currently in final year of secondary school or graduated no earlier than June of the preceding year.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: High school completion: A-Levels (Cambridge/Edexcel), IB Diploma, or Pakistani Intermediate (FSc/FA/ICS) with top-tier academic excellence.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 90%+ in FSc or straight A*/A grades in Cambridge A-Levels (predicted and final results).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Prerequisites vary by faculty (e.g., Mathematics and Physics for Engineering; Calculus for Rotman Commerce).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Secondary school student nominated by high school/college guidance counsellor.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must graduate high school in the current academic year or have graduated within the past 12 months with no post-secondary gap studies.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Focus on high school leadership, intellectual curiosity, school clubs, debate, Olympiads, and community engagement.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS 6.5 overall (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 100 with 22 in Writing, or Duolingo English Test (DET) minimum 120.

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; all eligible candidates welcome.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be explicitly nominated by their high school guidance counsellor before applying.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have already attended a college or university degree program.

tuition_fee.details: Covers 100% international undergraduate tuition fees at University of Toronto for 4 years.

admission_application_fee.details: Ontario Universities' Application Centre (OUAC) application fee paid by candidate (~CAD $250).

accommodation.details: Guaranteed full residence support in University of Toronto college dormitories for all 4 years.

monthly_stipend.details: Living expenses covered through residence room, board plan, and incidental book grant.

airfare.details: Travel flights to Toronto are arranged by student/family.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit fee (CAD $150) and biometrics fee paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: University Health Insurance Plan (UHIP) covered for international students.

food_allowance.details: Full meal plan included with college residence dining package.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full incidental book and supplies allowance provided annually.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: U of T undergraduate research opportunities (e.g. ROP programs) accessible.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local Toronto transit passes paid from incidental budget.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of Toronto (World Top 20).
participating_institutions: University of Toronto (St. George Downtown, UTM Mississauga, UTSC Scarborough)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Consistently ranked #1 in Canada and Top 20 globally (QS/THE/ARWU).
available_majors: Computer Science, Engineering Science, Rotman Commerce, Life Sciences, Economics, Architecture, Mathematics, Physics, Humanities, Social Sciences
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Must apply to direct-entry first-year program via OUAC by early deadlines.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: St. George campus Engineering Science and Rotman Commerce are most competitive.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: High school nomination is the key gatekeeper; ensure your school guidance counsellor nominates you early in October.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Toronto Pearson Scholarship Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Your school must first register and nominate you. Once nominated, U of T emails you a unique private application portal link.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. High school counsellor submits official nomination for you (Deadline: late November).
2. Apply for admission to U of T via OUAC 105 portal by mid-December.
3. Receive JOINid and credentials to log into U of T Pearson Scholarship portal.
4. Complete Pearson scholarship essays and activity profiles (Deadline: mid-January).
5. Upload predicted grades/transcripts and school references.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Concurrent: High school nomination + OUAC admission application + dedicated Pearson scholarship essays.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by high school guidance counsellor and referee teachers.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Reflect on how your actions have made a meaningful difference in your school or community and how you demonstrate creativity and independent thought.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not applicable; focus on undergraduate intellectual curiosity and extracurricular engagement.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed online activity sheet covering school clubs, leadership positions, honors, and community service.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions based strictly on nomination, academic transcripts, and written application dossiers.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: SAT/ACT optional; English language test mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: CAD $250 for OUAC university application; Pearson scholarship application itself has no fee.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: High school official transcripts stamped by school principal/counsellor; IBCC not required by U of T.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified English translation if school documents are in Urdu.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% Online via OUAC and U of T Applicant Portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official institutional nomination by high school principal or head of counselling
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Only 1 student can be nominated per high school per year in Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.specification: Grade 9, 10, 11 results and Grade 12 predicted grades (A-Levels or FSc-II)
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by school administration or Cambridge/BISE certificates

required_documents_checklist.specification: Original personal statement and creative impact essays written on portal
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Demonstrating exceptional impact, leadership, and resilience

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official electronic score report sent to University of Toronto

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: School nomination deadline is always late November; U of T OUAC admission deadline mid-December; scholarship essays due mid-January.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Outstanding high school academic achievement, straight A* / 90%+)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: University of Toronto Admissions Committee and Pearson Scholarship Selection Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic assessment identifying scholars with transformative leadership potential who are recognized as leaders in their schools.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1% (Typically 1 or 2 scholars per year from Pakistan)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Straight A*s in A-Levels or 92%+ in FSc
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Head boy/head girl, national debating champion, founder of non-profit initiative, international Olympiad medalist.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Past Pakistani winners from Karachi Grammar School, Aitchison College, Lahore Grammar School, Roots Millennium, Beaconhouse.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Global distribution across 30+ countries each year.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unapproved agencies claiming they can secure Pearson nominations independently of your school.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pearson application is free, but OUAC application fee of ~CAD $250 is standard university application fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Nomination must come directly from your recognized high school; agent nominations are disqualified.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian study permit fee and biometrics (~CAD $235).
International flights from Pakistan to Toronto (~PKR 350,000 to 500,000 round-trip).
Winter clothing and initial personal items buffer upon landing in Toronto.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can self-nominate if your school refuses. (Fact: High schools must be verified and submit the nomination; self-nominations are rejected).
MYTH: Multiple students from one school can get nominated. (Fact: Strictly 1 student per school per year).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some websites claim flights are covered; officially, international flights are NOT funded by Pearson.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.00 (B standing) and complete full-time course load (minimum 4.0 credits per year).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment on campus in Toronto.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual review by U of T Student Awards Office before renewing for subsequent years.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work on-campus and up to 20 hours/week off-campus during academic terms under Canadian Study Permit regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory home return rule; eligible for Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; active participation in Pearson scholar events and campus ambassador activities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Loss of award if student withdraws from university or fails to maintain minimum academic standard.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Award is non-transferable to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted to change major within eligible U of T faculties subject to faculty academic approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to a maximum of 4 years of undergraduate study; fifth-year extensions not funded.

official_sources_verified.source_name: University of Toronto - Lester B. Pearson International Scholarships Portal
data_points_missing_or_unpublished_by_so: Internal mathematical scoring rubric comparing A-Levels against local Pakistani FSc qualifications
